crop_clip: crop a list of numpy arrays or PIL images to a specified rectangular region
resize_clip: resize a list of numpy arrays or PIL images to a target size with bilinear interpolation
get_resize_sizes: compute the new height and width for resizing an image while preserving aspect ratio
normalize: normalize a 4D torch tensor video clip using mean and standard deviation values
is_tensor_clip: check if a given object is a 4D torch tensor representing a video clip
